svg.title: Awesome REA: what AI agents reverse-engineered and rebuilt, and which ones really used REA
svg.desc: Unofficial list of 110+ entries. Example rows: DX-Ball, on REA's official showcase, tagged REA; Universal Modder, a Claude Code and Codex plugin, tagged AI-RE; PhotoCraft, a clean-room rewrite, tagged Rebuild; Apple TV remote on Linux, no tool named, tagged Claim?.
